title: MCD inspects Chhath ghats in Delhi, directs officials to ensure facilities
description:
The Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) on Wednesday inspected Chhath ghats across the city and directed officials to ensure proper sanitation, lighting, security and other facilities for devotees ahead of the four-day festival beginning November 13.
According to an official statement, West Delhi MP Kamaljeet Sehrawat, MLA Pradyumn Rajput and MCD's South West Zone Deputy Commissioner Shashi Pratap Singh reviewed preparations at ghats in Sagarpur and Mahavir Enclave.
In the West Zone, Ward Committee Chairman Harish Oberoi and Deputy Commissioner Col Vinod Atri inspected the Chhath ghat at New Krishna Park in Vikaspuri and reviewed cleanliness, water supply, lighting and security arrangements.
